items.title: GTA 5 faces Elden Ring as Steam opens a Hall of Fame vote for past favourites
items.summary: Steam’s 2026 awards have opened nominations, and a new Hall of Fame category asks players to choose between games including Grand Theft Auto V, Elden Ring
items.content:
This article needs JavaScript to display. Please turn on JavaScript in your browser and reload the page. Steam’s 2026 awards have opened nominations, and a new Hall of Fame category asks players to choose between games including Grand Theft Auto V , Elden Ring and Baldur’s Gate 3 . It is part of Valve’s tenth anniversary edition of the community awards.

The nomination page is open until November 30 at 10 a.m. Pacific. Voting on the finalists begins on December 17 at 10 a.m. Pacific, giving players a separate chance to make their final choices.

The Hall of Fame is designed to bring past winners together, but there is an interesting detail behind the first two entries. Steam did not have a Game of the Year category in 2016 or 2017, so Valve used winners of other categories as stand-ins for those years.

The nomination page includes an Outstanding Story-Rich Game category. Image: Valve / PC Gamer

Valve’s current Hall of Fame screen shows GTA V for 2016 and The Witcher 3: Wild Hunt for 2017. In the page’s FAQ, Valve explains that it used the “Whoooaaaaaaaa, Dude” category for 2016 and “Choices Matter” for 2017 as proxies.

That means those two entries should not be mistaken for games that won a Steam Game of the Year award in those years. The 2016 archive and 2017 archive show the original category line-ups. Steam’s 2018 awards include a Game of the Year category, won by PUBG: Battlegrounds .

Other Hall of Fame choices displayed by Valve include Red Dead Redemption 2 , Resident Evil Village , Sekiro: Shadows Die Twice , Black Myth: Wukong and Hollow Knight: Silksong .

GTA V appears on the Hall of Fame ballot under 2016. Image: Rockstar Games / Steam

Alongside Game of the Year and VR Game of the Year, the nomination page includes Best Handheld Game, Labor of Love and three categories called Just Five More Minutes, Defies Description and This Is My Job Now.

For most categories, Valve says a game needs to have arrived on Steam after the previous year’s Autumn Sale. Labor of Love has different rules for older games, and Valve excludes earlier winners of that category. A non-limited Steam account is required to nominate and vote.

You can nominate a single game in more than one suitable category, change a nomination, or skip a category. Valve also offers a nomination committee badge, with additional tasks for raising its level.

The Witcher 3 fills the ballot’s 2017 slot. Image: CD Projekt Red / Steam

Open the awards page while signed into Steam, choose a category and select a game from the suggestions or search for one. I would check the category eligibility before nominating an older favourite, particularly for Labor of Love, because the rules are not identical across the ballot.

If the Hall of Fame sends you back to GTA V , Amazon lists a separate PC game code . Check its activation terms before buying: that retailer listing is separate from the Steam nomination page and should not be assumed to provide the Steam edition.

items.title: Get Elden Ring, Mafia: The Old Country, and More PS5 Games on Sale for $15 for Black Friday
items.content:
In the olden days (a few years ago) you had to wait until the actual day of Black Friday before the killer deals would crop up. Those days are officially gone. Now, before Black Friday official, Walmart has kicked off its “ Black Friday Event 2 ,” dropping some absolutely killer deals, and Amazon is price matching most of them. Among the discounts are a bunch of PS5 games on sale for just $15. These games are excellent and not that old. So grab what you want, because you’re not likely to find them cheaper any time soon.

What games are we talking? For starters, Mafia: The Old Country, an excellent single-player game that came out last year that our reviewer called “an effective return to the linear and tightly story-driven format of the original Mafia and Mafia II.”

Then there’s Assassin’s Creed Shadows , in which Ubisoft’s long-running series finally goes to Japan. We gave it an 8/10 in our review , saying, “By sharpening the edges of its existing systems, Assassin’s Creed Shadows creates one of the best versions of the open-world style it’s been honing for the last decade.”

Then there’s Borderlands 4 and Star Wars Outlaws and WWE 2K26, all fine games worth checking out if you haven’t already. Fifteen bucks will even get you Elden Ring, Fromsoft’s sprawling, open-world masterpiece that we gave a 10/10 in our review when it came out in 2022. That same year, we awarded it Game of the Year .

Other all-time low prices can be had now as well, like AirPods Pro 3 for $149 and Metal Gear Solid Master Collection Vol 2. for $29.99 .

items.title: Elden Ring: Rot & Sorcery Officially Confirmed For 2027
items.summary: Elden Ring: Rot & Sorcery arrives in 2027 for fans looking to explore the Lands Between again.
items.content:
Add ScreenRant on Google Add as Preferred Source Follow on Google Discover By Nicholas Becher Published Nov 23, 2026, 6:55 AM EST Nicholas Becher is a gaming journalist with an MFA in Creative Writing from FAU. With extensive experience playing video games, he covers all forms of gaming content at Screen Rant, from breaking news to the latest fan theories. Most-played games range from Clair Obscur to Civ to Elden Ring to Halo 2 and beyond. Sign in to your ScreenRant account Like Like follow Follow followed Followed Listen Thread Here is a fact-based summary of the story contents: Try something different: Show me the facts Explain it like I’m 5 Give me a lighthearted recap More than four years after its original release, Elden Ring remains one of the most influential fantasy games of its generation. FromSoftware's sprawling Lands Between set a new standard for open-world exploration, with the studio's signature style of world-building and unforgettable boss fights, not to mention the countless secrets that continue to draw players back.

The recent release of Elden Ring: Tarnished Edition on Nintendo Switch 2 has introduced an entirely new wave of players to the Lands Between, while giving longtime fans fresh reasons to return. Even so, fans are still holding out hope for a proper Elden Ring sequel, especially with FromSoftware's highly anticipated The Duskbloods recently delayed until 2027 .

With no official Elden Ring 2 announcement in sight, it's unclear when we'll get another massive adventure that can recapture the original game's magic. Fortunately, another exciting journey into the world of Elden Ring is now scheduled for 2027, with Rot & Sorcery offering fans a completely new way to experience the Lands Between.

Elden Ring: Rot & Sorcery is an upcoming adventure from Steamforged Games that will take players back to the Lands Between in 2027. Building on the success of the original Elden Ring: The Board Game , which launched through Kickstarter in 2022, the new release expands the experience with additional regions, enemies, characters, and campaigns inspired directly by FromSoftware's acclaimed RPG.

The game was originally announced in June 2025 before launching its crowdfunding campaign on Gamefound in August. Now, according to the game's official Gamefound page, the new content is scheduled for delivery in July 2027, although that remains an estimated fulfillment window.

Rot & Sorcery introduces two massive new core boxes, each offering its own standalone adventure. Machinations of the Witch takes players into Liurnia of the Lakes, where they'll encounter familiar enemies and formidable bosses, including Rennala, Queen of the Full Moon, and the Red Wolf of Radagon. Meanwhile, Dominion of Rot explores the terrifying wastelands of Caelid, where players can face the legendary Starscourge Radahn.

Both campaigns offer more than 30 hours of gameplay, featuring branching narratives, side quests, character customization, and challenging encounters. The cooperative experience supports between one and four players, with the tabletop adaptation recreating Elden Ring 's signature combat through an innovative diceless system.

Interestingly, players don't need to own the original board game to enjoy Rot & Sorcery , since both new core boxes are completely playable on their own. However, longtime fans can also combine the different releases to create an even larger adventure across the Lands Between.

There are also several additional expansions available through Gamefound, including the Altus Plateau, Rykard, Lord of Blasphemy, Ancestral, and Dragonkin Soldier expansions. Different pledge tiers offer varying combinations of these additions, with the Golden Pledge including both new core boxes and several major expansions.

With late pledges available through Gamefound, Rot & Sorcery offers Elden Ring fans another substantial adventure to look forward to in 2027, even if it isn't the traditional video game sequel they've been hoping for.

items.title: 6 Open-World RPGs With Virtually Perfect Exploration
items.summary: Most open-world games are only as good as the exploration the world offers, because without satisfying and rewarding exploration, there's no point.
items.content:
Elden Ring Screenshot with a night on a horse looking at the Urdtree Image via FromSoftware Add CBR on Google Add as Preferred Source Follow on Google Discover By Amber Frost Published Nov 22, 2026, 6:15 PM EST Amber is a CBR staff writer specializing in movies, television, and video games. Before joining CBR, she contributed to POPSUGAR and Looper , covering a wide range of entertainment topics. A fan of Marvel, Star Wars, Stranger Things, and horror films, Amber blends professional insight with authentic fandom. When she’s not writing, she’s gaming on her PlayStation 5, catching the latest films at her local theater, or relaxing with her cat. Sign in to your CBR account Like Like follow Follow followed Followed Listen Thread Here is a fact-based summary of the story contents: Try something different: Show me the facts Explain it like I’m 5 Give me a lighthearted recap Role-playing games (RPGs) go hand-in-hand with open-world maps. Obviously, not every RPG out there boasts an open-world design. It's not a requirement for a good game. For example, Baldur's Gate 3 doesn't have one technically seamless open world. Instead, it uses massive zones that mimic an open-world game, but are restricted to three different acts, forcing natural progression as the player makes their way through the story.

For RPGs that do choose to utilize a complete open world, it becomes a main feature in and of itself. An open-world game is only as good as it's open-world environment and the exploration of that environment. Sometimes, games waste these massive maps, earning reputations for being a walking simulator, or a world that's only big to swarm players with annoying hoards of enemies. This list will go over six incredible RPGs that have near-perfect exploration that's both rewarding and fun.

The Dragonborn walking through the world of Skyrim while wielding a giant axe in The Elder Scrolls V Skyrim Image via Bethesda The Elder Scrolls V: Skyrim , commonly shortened to just Skyrim , is a 2011 single-player action RPG that focuses more on player freedom than almost any other RPG out there. In fact, many fans of this game have claimed that the open-world exploration and the vast, never-ending environments are actually a bigger draw than the game's main campaign. Players can spend months playing this game and basically never touch the main story, because that's how good it is.

The main reason that Skyrim's exploration is so good is because of how dense it is. The map is massive, but it never feels empty. There are always points of interest to explore, leading to side quests, hidden secrets, and rewards. Detouring from the main path never feels like a waste of time, because players can do, experience, and learn so much about the game as they play. There are also basically no limits, either. If a player can see something on the horizon, they can probably reach it with enough determination.

4 graded cards, 6 seconds each. Faster answers score more.

Must be 18+/19+ to participate depending on jurisdiction.

Skyrim does an incredible job showing the player everything about the world. Each biome has distinct weather, flora, fauna, and even differing cultures that emphasize how people live or traverse that location. As the player explores, they're learning about the world state, the people, and various conflicts across the massive map, so there's never a moment when they aren't getting valuable information that makes this open-world RPG feel even more realistic.

elden ring waterfall boss arena Image via FromSoftware Elden Ring is a 2022 action RPG developed by FromSoftware. As a FromSoftware game, Elden Ring has garnered a lot of attention over the last four years. Not only did the game win Game of the Year, its 2024 expansion, Shadow of the Erdtree , was also nominated for Game of the Year despite only being a DLC. For the last four years, gamers have sung this game's praises for its challenging, Souslike combat, incredible world building by George R.R. Martin, and endless customization.

Elden Ring also happens to have an incredible open world that actually encourages gamers to explore naturally. Elden Ring can be an overwhelming game at the start because it lets players out into the world with very little instruction or indication of where to go. That can be a hindrance, but it's also Elden Ring's greatest strength, because instead of ticking tasks off a quest list and following a linear path, players have full control over their experience.

Rather than force players down a specific path, players can go anywhere and discover what the world has to offer on their own terms. Admittedly, this can definitely get players in trouble, as it is extremely easy to wander into higher level areas that players aren't prepared for. This replicates the feeling of a real, true adventure full of danger, surprises around every corner, and so many rewards to find. The good news is, players can set out on this journey with a friend or two, so they don't have to face the horrors alone.

The two main protagonists of Wuthering Waves together with other cast members around them in key art Image via Kuro Games Wuthering Waves is a free-to-play action RPG and gacha game, and it's a little bit different from the other RPGs on this list. Unlike Elden Ring or Skyrim , which released as a full game with the potential for DLC additions later on, Wuthering Waves is an ongoing game that gets an update every six weeks. Each new update adds to the ongoing story or unlocks another new region to explore, so the story and the map are constantly expanding.

Even when Wuthering Waves first came out in 2024, it boasted a massive open world to explore. Now the game is preparing for another major expansion with the introduction of New Federation (New Fed), in Version 4.0. There is a lot of ground to cover in Wuthering Waves , so new players might actually find the multiple massive maps overwhelming, but it is a deeply satisfying experience. Players can find chests, participate in open world challenges, and battle powerful enemies for even more rewards.

The best part about Wuthering Waves' open-world exploration is how it constantly evolves. When the game first released in 2024, players could parkour up the sides of mountains and buildings, cutting out the slow climbing from similar open-world games like Genshin Impact and The Legend of Zelda: Breath of the Wild . Since then, the game has introduced mechanics like wings for controlled flying, motorcycles for fast land traversal, and even augments for the bike that let it drive on water and fly. Wuthering Waves' exploration is fun and rewarding with none of the traditional frustration thanks to all the gadgets available to get around.

Horizon Forbidden West swimming Image via Guerrilla Games Horizon Forbidden West is a 2022 single-player action RPG and a direct sequel to Horizon Zero Dawn . Players once again control Aloy, a skilled hunter who lives in a post-apocalyptic world that once made up the Western United States. That's one of the coolest things about these games. The regions might not be what gamers know in real-life, but it's often easy to see where the inspiration comes from in regions inspired by massive cities like Los Angeles and San Francisco.

items.title: New Elden Ring Mini Replicas Arrive: Malenia, Messmer & Wylder
items.summary: Tarnished, collectors, and champions of the Lands Between, we're excited to unveil a new lineup of premium 1/3 Scale Mini Replicas inspired by some of the most iconic designs from the Elden Ring universe and crafted by Pure Arts. From the l
items.content:
Tarnished, collectors, and champions of the Lands Between, we're excited to unveil a new lineup of premium 1/3 Scale Mini Replicas inspired by some of the most iconic designs from the Elden Ring universe and crafted by Pure Arts. From the legendary Blade of Miquella, to the fearsome Messmer the Impaler, and the indominable warriors of Nightreign, these finely crafted collectibles capture the artistry and atmosphere that have made the Elden Ring universe unforgettable.

Elden Ring - Arm of Malenia Mini Replica (1/3 Scale)

Celebrate the unmatched elegance and strength of Malenia, Blade of Miquella, with this exquisite 1/3 scale replica of her prosthetic arm from Elden Ring. Meticulously sculpted and finished, the piece highlights every refined detail - from the intricate golden engravings to the articulated armor plating that defines her graceful yet deadly form. The arm's metallic sheen and subtle weathering evoke the beauty and ferocity of the demigoddess warrior. Presented on a simple black display base, it offers an elegant way to showcase this symbol of unwavering resolve.

Elden Ring - Helmet of Malenia Mini Replica (1/3 Scale)

Honor the legacy of Malenia, Blade of Miquella, with this meticulously crafted 1/3 scale replica of her legendary helmet from Elden Ring. Every detail reflects the beauty and ferocity of the demigoddess warrior, from the intricate engravings to the elegant winged crest that defines her unmistakable silhouette. The helmet's metallic finish and subtle weathering capture the essence of Malenia, Blade of Miquella's battle-worn armor. Presented on a simple black display stand, it offers an elegant and timeless way to display this symbol of strength and determination.

Elden Ring: Shadow of the Erdtree - Helmet of Messmer Mini Replica (1/3 Scale)

Embrace the dark majesty of Messmer the Impaler with this finely detailed 1/3 scale replica of his distinctive helmet from Elden Ring: Shadow of the Erdtree. Sculpted with precision, the piece captures the menacing elegance of Messmer the Impaler's design - from the elongated horns and ornate patterns to the burnished metallic finish that reflects his fiery power. The helmet's intricate craftsmanship evokes the regal yet fearsome aura of the Impaler himself. Presented on a simple black display stand, it provides a refined presentation worthy of this symbol of divine wrath.

Elden Ring Nightreign - Helmet of Wylder Mini Replica (1/3 Scale)

Enter the shadowed realm of Elden Ring Nightreign with this finely crafted 1/3 scale replica of the Wylder Helmet, an iconic piece of armor worn by the wandering knights of the darkened lands. This high-quality collectible captures every intricate detail of the original design, from the weathered metallic finish to the subtle engravings that mark its storied past. The helmet features a fabric neck veil, adding texture and realism to the piece. Presented on a simple black display stand, it offers an elegant way to showcase its imposing form.

Expand Your Collection

Each of these officially licensed mini replicas has been crafted by Pure Arts to faithfully capture the spirit, craftsmanship, and legendary designs of the Elden Ring universe. Whether your allegiance lies with Malenia, your fascination belongs to Messmer, or you're drawn to the mysteries of Nightreign, these collectibles are the perfect way to bring a piece of the Lands Between to your collection.

Which replica will earn a place on your shelf?

*This products are available on the Bandai Namco Store in Europe, Australia, the Middle East, India, and the United States.

items.title: I Tested Elden Ring On Switch 2 In A Cozy Cafe And It Ran Just Fine, Which Is Great News For A Remarkable Game
items.summary: You shouldn't play it in the rain/but you can play it on a train
items.content:
Elden Ring is an excellent, excellent video game. It’s got that smashy FromSoftware combat, a couple hundred boss fights that are all (mostly) unique and fun, character build customization for miles, a gorgeous and massive open world that’s a treat to explore, an intriguing story and hidden secrets, and a robust DLC that could be a game all its own. There’s a reason (well, many reasons!) why it’s almost universally critically acclaimed and still beloved by fans a few years after launch, too.

I love Elden Ring ! But when Ethan asked me to take on the review of the Tarnished Edition on Nintendo Switch 2, I wasn’t, like, stoked about it. I beat Elden Ring back when it first came out, easily dumping over 100 hours into the main game and probably another solid 40 or more into the DLC. And I played the Tarnished Edition at a preview event earlier this year for about 20 minutes, after which time I told everyone I spoke with about the experience that yup, that was Elden Ring all right! Elden Ring on a Switch 2! Game’s great, but I don’t necessarily need to play it again. What else is there to say?

It turns out, after playing for review, I do have one additional thing to say: Elden Ring is, apparently, pretty fun to play in public. Ideally at a cozy coffee shop with squoshy chairs where you can purchase hot London fogs to drink while you play.

Elden Ring was technically playable on the go before the Tarnished Edition , for folks with a Steam Deck. I have one of those, but the device, unlike the Switch 2, is not fun to take out in public. It’s heavy to hold, does not have a convenient kickstand, and you have to hold it in your hands to play if you don’t want to drag a controller around too. With the Switch 2, I could set the console on the table with the kickstand out, take the Joy-Cons off, lean back in my chair, and play Elden Ring while soothing cafe music played in the background. Every time I die (which is often), I get a nice sip of tea. I do not rage. I do not tense up. Helpfully, the cat (who is not here in the cafe with me) does not butt her head against the triggers and cause me to swing my sword randomly. Life is good.

In basically every other respect, I stick to my guns from the preview: this is Elden Ring ! It’s on the Switch 2 now! There were concerns after the first round of early previews that it ran poorly, but those were fixed by the time I previewed it earlier this year and remain fixed now. It runs fine. There are still occasional little framerate drops and yeah, it doesn’t look quite as nice as it will on your PS5 or Xbox Series, but who cares? It still plays great. The minor technical compromises didn’t interfere with combat in any way that was meaningful to me. It still looks good. It’s still lovely to stand on a cliff’s edge and look out in the direction of the Erdtree, the sun’s rays glistening through the clouds and a skyline of crumbling ruin all around.

I should mention that the Tarnished Edition does not have any meaningful new features. There are four new armor sets, a bit of customization for Torrent, and two new starting classes. Unfortunately, two of those new armor sets are starting sets for the two new classes, Heavy Knight and Idus Knight. I played as the Idus Knight and replaced my armor almost immediately with some tunic thing I got off a knight in the very first part of Limgrave, because it had better stats. I think I wore this same tunic when I played the game the first time. Shame, because the new starting armor genuinely looked great. I found the addition of these two new classes to be extremely whatever: you’re going to customize all your stats and replace all your gear almost immediately anyway. The Idus Knight was just a Samurai two levels lower, with different equipment. These additions did nothing for me, and certainly will do nothing for anyone after the first hour of game.

This release does include the superb Shadow of the Erdtree DLC, bundled right in from the start, though. That rules.

But who cares? It’s Elden Ring , on Switch 2! I can easily play it on a plane or on a train, in a box or with a fox, here or there, anywhere! I can take it to bars, to rooftop wine parties. I can play it outside on a patio with a cold one in a koozie next to me as the summer sun sets. I recognize that this is just effectively restating the main gimmick of the Nintendo Switch and Switch 2, but I admittedly haven’t taken my Switch 2 out much since it launched last year. Elden Ring , the best game of 2022 and arguably one of the best games of the decade, is a great excuse to do so. Give it a shot. Order yourself a latte or, a little later in the day, maybe a nice glass of pinot noir, bust out your Switch 2, and give it a shot.

This article was corrected post-publication: Limveld is Nightreign , Limgrave is Elden Ring . I can never keep them straight.

items.title: The next game from Hoyoverse sure looks like someone put Elden Ring's clothes on Monster Hunter
items.content:
Action The next game from Hoyoverse sure looks like someone put Elden Ring's clothes on Monster Hunter News By Lincoln Carpenter Published 25 August 2026 Who among us doesn't love to sever the Dreadnodus?

(Image credit: Hoyoverse) {alert('Link copied')}).catch(err => {console.error('Failed to copy: ', err)})" data-platform="copy_link" data-action="" class="font-ui-heading py-2 text-sm text-neutral-700 hover:bg-neutral-100 transition-colors no-underline block cursor-pointer border-0 bg-transparent w-full text-left normal-case" aria-label="Copy link" role="menuitem" data-analytics-id="article-social" analytics-label="utility-bar-social-share-copy-link" analytics-name="utility-bar-secondary" data-mrf-recirculation="article-social"> Copy link Facebook X Reddit Pinterest Flipboard Email Share this article 1 Join the conversation Follow us Add us as a preferred source on Google Newsletter Subscribe to our newsletter As the opening reveal of this year's Gamescom Opening Night Live, HoYoverse brought its first official look at Nodusfall—a change of pace for the gacha game behemoth that looks a little bit Elden Ring , a lot bit Monster Hunter, and a whole pile of proper nouns added for good measure.

While I like to think it takes more to catch my attention than forcefully mashing together two things I think are neat, I'd be lying if I said I wasn't tempted by the idea. If there's one thing Monster Hunter monsters have been missing, it's FromSoft-style primordial depression.

Watch On From the looks of things, there's more than enough metaphysical malaise to go around in Nodusfall. The laws of divinity have apparently frayed, plunging creation into a state of cosmic disarray. There are 10 suns now. Ideally, there's only supposed to be one of those. Not great!

Luckily for those of us who like to be given an excuse to try to fight a lizard 30 times our size, all that profound devastation seems to have produced a wide selection of giant, charismatic creatures to swordfight alongside your friends. In the reveal trailer embedded above, I saw giant bears, some sort of giant pack foxes, a horned, winged manticore, and a dragon or two (giant). I don't yet know how Nodusfall's progression works, but if I'm not allowed to harvest all their individual pieces and turn them into pants, I'm going to feel personally betrayed.

While the glimpses of combat shown in the footage looks like it hews pretty closely to the pace and rhythm of Monster Hunter, Nodusfall does seem to be dropping a few original elements into the mix. At one point, one of the player characters uses some sort of transformation ability to become a giant, armored knight in the middle of a hunt. And later, two players perform an elaborate, paired execution animation.

Nodusfall isn't Elden Ring, Monster Hunter or a typical HoYoverse game—it's something very different HoYoverse's Nodusfall is free to play but isn't a typical gacha game: 'Characters are not obtained through random draws' All the key details on HoYo's co-op monster slayer Nodusfall What remains to be seen is what sort of monetization scheme Nodusfall will be wrapped in—something that HoYoverse's history doesn't exactly inspire confidence about. If I have to do gacha pulls for a gunlance, I'm going to have a hard time.

Nodusfall doesn't have much of an online presence yet, so it'll likely be a while before we can expect a release date.

items.title: Rise with ELDEN RING Tarnished Edition, launching Aug. 28 on Nintendo Switch 2
items.summary: Pre-order available. Explore a breathtaking world full of excitement and mystery.
items.content:
08/11/26 Pre-order now Rise with ELDEN RING Tarnished Edition, launching Aug. 28 on Nintendo Switch 2 The Lands Between—a place of myth, gods, and broken dreams. Long ago, Queen Marika and her divine offspring reigned here, but since the Elden Ring was shattered, the world has fallen into decay. Now, the land whispers for a King.

The “Tarnished,” long exiled, are finally seeing the light of Grace once more. Step into this hauntingly beautiful realm, unravel its ancient mysteries, and rise as the one true Elden Lord.

The ELDEN RING Tarnished Edition game arrives on the Nintendo Switch™ 2 system on August 28 .

The Lands Between are part of a vast continent, where magnificent open fields and huge dungeons with complex three-dimensional designs are seamlessly connected. As you explore, the joy of discovering unknown and overwhelming threats awaits you.

Mastery of the terrain and knowledge of its secrets can help you overcome enemies and defeat formidable bosses—or lead invading players into traps.

The founding mythology of Elden Ring was written by George R. R. Martin and adapted into a rich multilayered story. Intersecting goals and desires between the characters create an intense narrative that weaves throughout the Lands Between. The events of the game can unravel in many ways—depending on your interventions.

Combat is simple to learn yet offers hidden depths of dexterity. As you seek to become the Elden Lord, you’ll need to explore the balance between attacking, avoiding damage, using a wide variety of weapons, spells, summons, and perfecting your timing to take advantage of your opponents’ weaknesses.

In addition to customizing the appearance of your character, there are countless ways to combine the weapons, armor, usable items, and magic that you equip. You can develop your character according to your play style.

No matter if you prefer bold physical confrontation, tactical spellcasting, or the subtle art of stealth, you’ll be able to find gear that supports your choices.

Traverse together with other Nintendo Switch 2 players. You can play with up to two other Tarnished as your cooperative teammates, either by inviting them using a shared password or by summoning them from a pool of nearby community members.

There are also ample opportunities to face off against other players, either through co-op invasions, invited duels, or the many player battle options available in the three Colosseums.

items.title: Elden Ring Director Reveals Spiritual Successor Titles Are In Development
items.summary: The master of RPGs is set to strike again
items.content:
Dark Souls and Elden Ring creator Hidetaka Miyazaki appears to be back at it again.

Arguably two of the most era-defining games of all time, Dark Souls and Elden Ring are masterpieces.

Hailing from gargantuan Japanese studio FromSoftware, the RPGs have paved the way for an industry of successful mock-ups, and we've been waiting with bated breath to see what will come next.

Now, it looks like numerous games are in the works at the company, as Miyazaki let slip of 'unnamed' projects in the pipeline, amid a shareholder power struggle.

Back in 2024, hot off the back of the Shadow of the Erdtree expansion, FromSoftware parent company Kadokawa Corporation teased that it was working on 26 new games , the large majority of them coming to consoles and PC.

This spurred many people on to believe in an Elden Ring successor.

Now, Miyazaki has followed up on this, commenting on the influence of a new investor group that has trumped the shares of Sony in FromSoftware, but has a history of turning games into microtransaction-heavy revenue streams.

In a statement to Japanese outlet Denfaminico Gamer , the Elden Ring creator said that although he is aware of the ongoing business, he was happy with the creative environment at the studio.

"I’m not saying that there’s no room for improvement, but we can freely make the kind of games we want to make without excessive interference," he said

“I think for both myself and for FromSoftware, the most important thing going forward is to maintain this environment and focus as much as possible on game development.

"[Players] will look forward to both the announced and unannounced titles to come.”

On the 'announced' front, this relates to the upcoming Nintendo Switch 2 action game, The Duskbloods , and Elden Ring's port to the same console.

In fact, there's nothing in the way of console and PC games that we know of.

Previously, Miyazaki has flip-flopped between the future of Elden Ring , first claiming that some lore reveals are being withheld for a sequel, before backtracking and ruling out a follow-up game .

items.title: What Is Elden Ring About?
items.summary: Discover what Elden Ring is about: a dark fantasy epic by FromSoftware & George R.R. Martin, set in a vast open world. Join 30M+ players and become the next Elden Lord!
items.content:
The legend of ELDEN RING is a dark fantasy epic born from a collaboration between two masters of the genre.

Using the seed of a story about bloodline, heritage and betrayal written by George R.R. Martin , Hidetaka Miyazaki and FromSoftware have crafted a vast and beautiful wilderness out of the ruins of a kingdom fractured by war between demigods.

After the assassination of Godwyn the Golden , her oldest son, god queen Marika shattered the Elden Ring that was the source of her power. Her remaining children took up these pieces for themselves. Using the might these runes gave them, the Demigods fought to become her successor, each driven by their own motives.

However, this maddening war was a stalemate with no clear victor. The Demigods retreated to their respective realms as the world fell further and further into stagnation, the Golden Order sundered.

But now, a group of banished warriors known as the Tarnished are returning to the Lands Between . You are one of those Tarnished , the dead who yet live, drawn by the guidance of what grace remains to seek the throne and become the next Elden Lord .

Read more about the story of ELDEN RING’s Age of the Gods, the history crafted by George R.R. Martin and Hidetaka Miyazaki.

The world of ELDEN RING is dangerous and majestic. Pale grasslands lead to flooded plains where dragons roost. A crimson battlefield now seethes under scarlet swamps of rot. You’ll climb frozen mountains, search through mystical forests, conquer golden kingdoms, and that’s only the beginning.

All of these rich landscapes are host to deadly enemies and wonderous secrets. There are caves and deep crypts guarded by traps, forts that have fallen to rebellions, and ruins of past civilizations that are now home to monsters and madmen.

Most intricate of all are the vast legacy dungeons like Stormveil castle , whose ramparts crown the high hills of Limgrave . Many of these sprawling dungeons host the remaining Demigods who guard their Great Runes within.

As you travel, you may also find the few souls who remain in the land still possessed of their wits and intellect. Most still retain their ambitions as well and may ask for your help. Aid or hinder them as you see fit, either way could benefit you in some manner if you are wise.

Prepare to explore the Lands Between with our ELDEN RING Starter Guide.

For over a decade FromSoftware have created an iconic system of gameplay that influenced countless other games. The broader gaming culture has defined titles that take their inspiration from the Souls series as being part of a “Soulslike” genre .

The Souls series has many unique features, but the genre is defined by three main features. All Souls series games have combat focused on precise timing and evasion that is simple to learn but challenging to master.

They also include a system that requires the player to survive between checkpoints at the risk of losing the currency they receive from defeating enemies that is used to purchase stat upgrades. And of course, the Souls series feature intense, memorable boss fights that test the player’s skills to progress through the story.

He joined the news team in 2022 and accidentally fell upwards into a senior position despite his best efforts. For reasons unknown, he enjoys analyzing box office receipts , giant sharks, and has become known as the go-to man for all things Bosch , Mission: Impossible and Christopher Nolan in Collider's news division. Recently, he found himself yeehawing along to the Dutton saga on the Yellowstone Ranch. He is proficient in sarcasm, wit, Photoshop and working unfeasibly long hours. Amongst his passions sit the likes of the history of the Walt Disney Company, the construction of theme parks , steam trains and binge-watching Gilmore Girls with a coffee that is just hot enough to scald him. R. Martin’s fantasy fingerprints are still all over some of the biggest stories ever told and, while most fans know him best for Game of Thrones , his work on Elden Ring helped give FromSoftware one of the most detailed and epic fantasy settings in gaming. The Lands Between already made the jump from massive open-world RPG to a film being shot now, but it's expanded through different games and spin-offs and now it's getting another life in a very different format.

A new Elden Ring Nightreign tabletop RPG will officially launch on June 19, 2026, adapting the co-op action RPG of the same name from last year into a pen and paper experience. The game is set in Limveld which is an alternate version of the world as seen in the original Elden Ring, but it's fallen into chaos. Not good. Now it's full of powerful monsters, danger lurking around every corner and hours of suffering. Pretty natural fit for tabletop horror-fantasy fans., even if adapting the speed and intensity of Elden Ring combat into a tabletop format is not exactly the world’s easiest assignment.

For now, the tabletop RPG has only been confirmed for Japan, but an English-language release is not impossible. Other Japanese tabletop games have received English localizations in the past, including adaptations based on major gaming properties like Shin Megami Tensei .

Production is underway on the Elden Ring movie, and Alex Garland is writing and directing the live-action adaptation, with the movie set for a March 3, 2028 theatrical release and being filmed for IMAX. The cast is staggering as well, including names as varied as Kit Connor , Cailee Spaeny , Ben Whishaw , Nick Offerman , Tom Burke , Havana Rose Liu , Sonoya Mizuno , Emma Laird , Peter Serafinowicz , Jonathan Pryce , Ruby Cruz , John Hodgkinson , and Jefferson Hall. Martin is onboard as a producer alongside Andrew Macdonald, Allon Reich, Peter Rice, and Vince Gerardis.

The plot of the film is still up in the air a little bit. It's expected to follow the shattered Elden Ring and the corrupted demigods of the Lands Between, but it’s not yet clear whether Garland is adapting the main Tarnished storyline directly or building a new story that he's blending in with the rest.

Elden Ring Nightreign TRPG launches in Japan on June 19, 2026.
